beats.event: Born prince of Ayodhya, incarnation of Vishnu
Aids sage Vishwamitra, slays demoness Tataka
Strings Janaka's bow and marries Sita
Named heir; Ayodhya prepares his coronation
Kaikeyi's boons: Rama exiled 14 years to forest
Peaceful hermitage life with Sita and Lakshmana
Defeats Khara and Dushan after Shurpanakha attack
Sita abducted by Ravana; Jatayu slain
Allies with Sugriva; kills Vali, gains vanara army
Hanuman finds Sita in Lanka, returns with her comb
Vanaras build Rama Setu; army crosses to Lanka
Lakshmana felled by Meghnada; sanjeevani revives him
Rama slays Ravana; Vibhishana crowned in Lanka
Sita's agni pariksha; Agni restores her, gods glorify Rama
Coronation in Ayodhya; Rama Rajya begins
Gossip about Sita; Rama banishes her to Valmiki's ashram
Twins Lava and Kusha reunited with Rama at Ashvamedha
Sita calls on Earth Mother; ground opens, she departs
Rama walks into Sarayu, merges with Vishnu
